html: Graduated from IIT Roorkee and joined HiLabs as a Data Scientist. Now building our first LLM-inference GPU infrastructure: a serving framework that does GPU-aware request routing, autoscaling, and KV-cache sharing to cut token spend and speed up inference for fine-tuned SLMs.
"Trust the Subject, Cap the Item" (capped amortized IRT) won the Predictive AI Evaluation Challenge; write-up submitted to the AIMS workshop at COLM 2026.
Started Google Summer of Code 2026 with GNU Octave, rewriting the ANOVA stack as an object-oriented framework.
Interned at HiLabs: improved the OCR pipeline and the webpage-classifier model, built agentic memory for an internal agent framework, and prototyped parallel document splitting.
Silver at Inter-IIT Tech Meet 14.0: 1st runner-up on the ISRO geospatial VLM problem statement among 24 IITs.
Received a pre-placement offer from HiLabs after winning the HiLabs AIQuest hackathon at IIT Roorkee.
Data science intern at Info Edge, working on generative engine optimisation (GEO).
Silver in Tech GC, IIT Roorkee, for an AI interview platform.
